heading: Calculating with substances and reactions
intro: All the data you need is in the question. Round to the correct number of digits.

questions.question: What is the formula for the concentration of a solution?

answers.a: concentration = mass of dissolved substance : volume of solution
answers.b: concentration = volume of solution : mass of dissolved substance
